response.overview: A new musical conceived by novelist Jodi Picoult and playwright Timothy Allen McDonald, told in five interlocking suites that follow how the COVID-19 pandemic affects five very different relationships. Each suite has its own songwriting team, with a cast including Kelli O'Hara, Brian Stokes Mitchell, Denée Benton, Patti Murin, Colin Donnell and Matt Doyle. Filmed without an audience at the 92nd Street Y's Kaufmann Concert Hall in March 2021 and premiered on Overture+.
response.title: Breathe
